title: Admin tools
description:
We require various admin tools so that certain things can be configured/viewed or modified.

We will require a second login way where an admin user (authenticated solely via a different Cognito table than the users) can access certain endpoints.
The first few endpoints that we require:
- get user profiles, listing all the users in the system and their profiles
- get user conversations, listing a given users conversations log
- get user activity log, listing a given users endpoint interactions

features.title: Setup Admin Module and Admin Cognito Authentication
features.description:
Create a new @src/admin/admin.module.ts . Add configuration for a new Admin Cognito user pool. Implement an `AdminCognitoStrategy` and an `AdminAuthGuard` to secure admin-only endpoints.

Both the admin module and @src/auth/auth.module.ts should use NestJS's PasssportModule and essentially follow the same exact patterns.
This should be documented and enforced in @docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md and @docs/CODE_STANDARD.md

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List All User Profiles
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users` within the `admin` module, protected by the `AdminAuthGuard`. This endpoint will use the `UserProfilesRepository` to fetch and return a paginated list of all user profiles.

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List User Conversation Logs
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users/:userId/conversations` in the `admin` module. Secured by the `AdminAuthGuard`, it will retrieve a paginated list of conversation logs for the specified user using the `ConversationLogsRepository`.

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List User Activity Logs
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users/:userId/activity` in the `admin` module. Protected by the `AdminAuthGuard`, this endpoint will fetch a paginated list of activity logs for the specified user from the `ActivityLogsRepository`.

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List User audio recordings
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users/:userId/files/audio` in the `admin` module. Protected by the `AdminAuthGuard`, this endpoint will fetch a paginated list of audio file urls for the specified user.

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List User Moods
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users/:userId/moods` in the `admin` module. Protected by the `AdminAuthGuard`, this endpoint will fetch a paginated list of moods for the specified user.

features.title: Implement Admin Endpoint to List User journals
features.description: Create an endpoint `GET /admin/users/:userId/journals` in the `admin` module. Protected by the `AdminAuthGuard`, this endpoint will fetch a paginated list of journals for the specified user.

features.title: Admin auth endpoints and access-token validation
features.description:
Introduce admin authentication endpoints and update JWT validation so clients can log in and use access tokens for subsequent admin calls.

Scope:
- Add unauthenticated admin auth endpoints under `/admin/auth`:
  - POST `/admin/auth/login` — authenticate against the Admin Cognito User Pool using USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and return tokens `{ accessToken, idToken, refreshToken, expiresIn, tokenType }`. Compute and pass SECRET_HASH if a client secret is configured.
  - POST `/admin/auth/forgot-password` — trigger Cognito ForgotPassword for the username.
  - POST `/admin/auth/reset-password` — confirm password reset with `{ username, confirmationCode, newPassword }`.
- Update Admin Cognito JWT strategy to accept and validate Cognito Access Tokens:
  - Verify issuer and signature via JWKS (RS256), ignore audience claim, and validate `token_use === 'access'` and `client_id === configured clientId`.
- Keep existing admin endpoints protected via the admin guard; do NOT guard the new auth endpoints.
- Add DTOs, Swagger docs, validation, and unit tests for controller and strategy changes.

Out of scope:
- Registration (handled via Cognito UI) and token refresh endpoint (can be a separate feature).

Notes:
- Admin User Pool App Client has ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH enabled. Client secret is set, so the service will compute SECRET_HASH using HMAC-SHA256(username + clientId, clientSecret).
